args.content:
HAWAII VACATION PACKING LIST

ESSENTIALS:
- Passport/ID
- Sunglasses
- Sunscreen (SPF 30+)
- Hat or cap
- Beach towel
- Flip-flops or sandals
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Swimwear (multiple sets)
- Beach bag

CLOTHING:
- Light, breathable clothing (t-shirts, shorts, sundresses)
- Light jacket or cardigan (for air-conditioned spaces)
- Rain jacket or poncho (for sudden showers)
- Underwear and socks
- Pajamas

TOILETRIES:
- Toothbrush and toothpaste
- Shampoo and conditioner
- Body wash
- Deodorant
- Razor and shaving cream
- Hairbrush/comb
- Hair ties
- Sunscreen
- Insect repellent
- Hand sanitizer
- Moisturizer
- Contact lens solution (if applicable)
- Prescription medications
- First aid kit

ELECTRONICS:
- Phone and charger
- Camera and charger
- Power bank
- Headphones
- Universal adapter (if needed)
- Laptop/tablet (optional)

BEACH & WATER ACTIVITIES:
- Snorkeling gear (mask, snorkel, fins)
- Beach umbrella
- Water bottle
- Beach games (frisbee, volleyball)
- Waterproof phone case
- Waterproof bag for valuables

MISCELLANEOUS:
- Cash and credit cards
- Travel insurance documents
- Hotel/rental car information
- Emergency contacts
- Guidebooks or maps
- Travel pillow
- Earplugs
- Eye mask
- Laundry detergent sheets (if staying long-term)
